============== INTRODUCTION ================ Test Scenario: Verify end-to-end flight flagging and unflagging (First Flag -> Then Unflag) across Ongoing and Incoming sections. Steps: 1. Authenticate / Login to application (managed via @pytest.mark.login). 2. Navigate to Flights List View. 3. Iterate through Ongoing and Incoming sections: a. Switch to the section tab. b. Validate flight cards are visible. c. Locate target flight card and ensure it is initially unflagged (reset by unflagging if already flagged). d. Flag the flight (select flag from dropdown by text value, click Save). e. Verify and assert that the flight is now in FLAGGED state. f. Unflag the flight (click unmark icon, confirm Unflag in dialog). g. Verify and assert that the flight is now in UNFLAGGED state.
